playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.text: Built together from your Plex music library.
playlists.emptyOperator: Not connected to Plex yet. Connect your Plex account under <settings>Settings</settings>.
playlists.textReady: {{tracks}} tracks from your Plex library “{{library}}” · everything ends up as a playlist in Plex, and so in Plexamp and Music Assistant too.
playlists.notConnectedMember: The operator has not connected Plex yet. As soon as the library is in, you can start here.
playlists.loadingText: The whole library once, after that only what is new. With a large library this takes a few minutes.
playlists.noneText: The catalogue is here: {{tracks}} tracks from “{{library}}”. The playlists you build together will show up here.
playlists.failedOperator: The catalogue could not be fetched: {{reason}} More under <settings>Settings</settings>.
playlists.failedMember: The catalogue could not be fetched yet. The operator will look into it in the settings.

trash.title: Trash
trash.text: Deleted playlists stay here for {{days}} days, then they are gone for good.
trash.purgeText: “{{name}}” is gone afterwards and cannot be brought back.
trash.smartText: “{{name}}” was a smart playlist and was deleted in Plex. It comes back as an ordinary playlist with its last {{count}} tracks and is made in Plex anew that way. Plex no longer fills it by itself.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.text: Hidden from your overview only. In Plex and for everybody else, everything stays as it is.

playlists.chooseServer: Where should the tracks come from?
playlists.chooseServerText: The playlist searches, suggests and plays previews from this library.

sync.waiting: Waiting for Plex. Your changes stay here and are written later.
sync.smart: Smart playlist from Plex, read only
sync.smartEmpty: Plex finds nothing for this smart playlist right now.
sync.noteTitle: Sorted in Plex at the same time
sync.noteText: The order was changed here and in Plex at the same time. This one now applies in Plex too. Undo takes the order from Plex.
sync.deleteText: “{{name}}” then lies in the trash for {{days}} days and can be restored until then. It disappears from Plex at once; restoring makes it there again.

plex.title: Playlists
plex.none: None yet. Playlists from Plex appear here by themselves.
plex.lookedValue: {{when}} · then every 15 seconds, reordering in Plex within {{minutes}} minutes

sync.local: Only in nexmix. nexmix does not make playlists in Jellyfin yet.

settings.title: Settings

language.title: Language
language.text: Applies to your account. The others choose their own. The operator adds more languages under Settings, Languages.

settings.text: The server, the accounts and the sign-in. Everything personal is under My account.

auth.name: Name
auth.nameHint: You sign in with it: 2 to 64 letters without accents, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
auth.guestNote: Guest at a party? You need no account for that: scan the code or open the link you were given.

setup.title: Set up nexmix
setup.text: The first account runs this server: it invites people and may change every setting.
setup.codeHint: It stands in the server log (docker logs nexmix), or set NEXMIX_SETUP_TOKEN.

login.title: Sign in
login.passwordOff: Sign-in with a password is turned off here. Only the operator can still use it.

code.title: Second factor
code.text: The code from your app, or a recovery code.
code.label: Code from the app
code.hint: Six digits. Or one of your recovery codes.
code.textPasskey: Sign in with your passkey, or give a recovery code.

invite.title: Welcome to nexmix
invite.text: {{name}} has invited you as a member. Choose a name and a password, or sign in through a provider.
invite.textAnonymous: You are invited as a member. Choose a name and a password, or sign in through a provider.
invite.invalidText: This invitation no longer works: it was used, has run out or was withdrawn. Ask for a new one.
invite.noWay: Sign-in with a password is off and no sign-in provider is set up. Ask the operator.
invite.haveAccount: This link is for a new account. You are signed in as {{name}} already and do not need it.

remember.label: Stay signed in on this device
remember.hint: Good for your own phone, not for other people's devices.
remember.ends_one: Until you have not been here for {{count}} day.
remember.ends_other: Until you have not been here for {{count}} days.

setup2fa.title: Set up your second factor
setup2fa.text: The operator requires a second factor for every account that signs in with a password. Set it up to go on.
setup2fa.scan: Scan the code with an authenticator app, or type in the key. Then the code the app shows.
setup2fa.passkeyLater: Rather without an app? You can add a passkey afterwards under My account › Security.

codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.text: Each one signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now: keep them apart from the phone.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.text: Enter your name or your mail address. If there is an account with a mail address for it, we send a link with which you choose a new password.
forgot.label: Name or mail address
forgot.sent: If there is such an account, a link is on its way. It works once and for 24 hours.

reset.title: New password
reset.text: Choose a new password for {{name}}. Every device signs in again afterwards. Your second factor stays.
reset.invalidText: This link does not work any more: it was used or has run out. Ask for a new one, or tap "Forgot your password?" when signing in.
reset.doneText: You can sign in with the new password now.

mail.title: Confirm the mail address
mail.text: {{address}} was given for the account {{name}}. Confirm it with one click.
mail.oldTold: We told the old address about the change.
mail.invalidText: This link does not work any more: it was used, has run out or was withdrawn. Send yourself a new one under My account.

about.subtitle: Build playlists together from your Plex music library.
about.fontsText: nexmix brings its fonts along, so that opening it asks no other server.

updates.title: Updates
updates.text: Whether a newer version of nexmix is out.
updates.dailyHint: Asks GitHub for the newest release when somebody opens this page, once a day at most. Off: only when you press the button.
updates.none: Cannot be checked right now: there is no release yet, or GitHub cannot be reached.
updates.whatGoesOut: Only the question goes out: a request to api.github.com for the newest release of nexmix, with no names or settings. Besides your Plex server, plex.tv while connecting, the mail server, if you set it up, the push services of the browsers and the sign-in providers when somebody signs in through them, it is the only call nexmix makes on its own.

me.title: My account

profile.text: How the others on this server see you.
profile.displayHintPassword: Empty shows your user name {{name}}; you still sign in with it.
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: A photo from your phone or camera. It is cut to a square, and nothing of the file but the picture is kept: no place, no device.

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Every other device is signed out.

me.setupFirst: The operator requires a second factor. Set it up here, then you can go on.

push.title: Notifications on your devices
push.text: Notices come as a push straight to the phone or into the browser, even while nexmix is closed. You sign up each device on its own.
push.name: Name of the device
push.ready: Not signed up yet. The browser will ask whether nexmix may send notifications.
push.denied: The browser blocked notifications for nexmix. Allow them in the settings of the site (the lock left of the address), then carry on here.
push.insecure: This address has no https, so push does not work. Open nexmix at its https address.
push.iphone: On the iPhone it only works from the app on the home screen. Put nexmix there and open it from there.
push.hintHttps: Push needs an address with https (or localhost).
push.hintIphone: On the iPhone it only works from the app on the home screen: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. From iOS 16.4.
push.deniedNow: Notifications are not allowed. Without them nexmix cannot send anything.
push.probeHint: Arrives on every device signed up.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.ends_one: A sign-in ends by itself after {{count}} day without use.
devices.ends_other: A sign-in ends by itself after {{count}} days without use.
devices.notify: Tell me about a new sign-in
devices.notifyHint: By push to your devices and by mail: which device, which browser, roughly from where. If it was not you, one tap signs it off.
devices.endedAll: Every other device is signed out.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or the device's PIN, without password and without code. A passkey counts as two factors by itself and cannot be phished.
passkeys.how: The browser will ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN. The passkey stays on the device or in your keychain.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.removeText: Nobody gets in with this passkey afterwards. Delete it on the device too when you no longer need it.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys work only over https (or localhost) and in browsers that know them.
passkeys.noAddressOperator: Enter the public address first (<settings>Settings › Sign-in</settings>).
passkeys.noAddressMember: Your operator has to enter the public address first.

oidc.addressOffer: {{provider}} knows you as {{address}}. Should nexmix take this address?
oidc.addressTaken: The address is your account's now. Confirm it under Profile, then it counts for notices by mail too.

me.keysWait: Devices and API keys work only once you set up a second factor.
me.text: Your profile, your security and your devices.

twofactor.title: Second factor
twofactor.lead: Besides the password, a code from an app on your phone. Recovery codes on paper get you in when the phone is gone.
twofactor.scan: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then give the code the app shows, and your password.
twofactor.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twofactor.passwordHint: Proves it is you at the keyboard.
twofactor.codesLead: Each code signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now.
twofactor.renewText: The old recovery codes stop working. Give your password to make new ones.
twofactor.disableText: From then on the password alone signs you in. Give it to turn the second factor off.
twofactor.lowCodes: Few recovery codes left. Make new ones while you can still sign in.
twofactor.scanNoPassword: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then give the code the app shows.
twofactor.required: It cannot be turned off: the operator requires it for everybody.

invite.noMail: Without a mail server nexmix sends nothing: copy the link and pass it on yourself.
invite.once: The link works once. It is shown only now.

guestInvite.title: Invite guests
guestInvite.text: Whoever has the link or the code only types their name. No account, no app. Guests see only this playlist and the search.
guestInvite.qr: QR code of the invitation to “{{name}}”
guestInvite.validFor_one: Valid for {{count}} hour · after that the invitation is over for every guest.
guestInvite.validFor_other: Valid for {{count}} hours · after that the invitation is over for every guest.
guestInvite.validUntil: Valid until {{time}} · after that the invitation is over for every guest.
guestInvite.reachHome: Phones outside your Wi-Fi cannot reach this address.
guestInvite.reachMachine: Only this computer opens this address. Phones cannot reach it.
guestInvite.reachSet: Set the public address under Settings › Server › Sign-in.
guestInvite.maySort: May sort and remove tracks of others
guestInvite.maySortHint: Without it, each guest removes only their own.
guestInvite.previewHint: 30 seconds from a good third into the track, passed through nexmix. Your Plex key stays on the server.
guestInvite.previewOffServer: Listening in is switched off on this server (Settings › Plex).
guestInvite.removeText: {{name}} is out at once and does not get back in from this browser. With the link, {{name}} can join as a new guest while the invitation runs. To keep everybody out, end the invitation. This cannot be undone. The tracks {{name}} added stay in the playlist.
guestInvite.endText: Every guest is out at once and the link leads nowhere. This cannot be undone, a new invitation gets a new code. The guests' tracks stay in the playlist.
guestInvite.ended: Invitation ended. Guests no longer get in.

guest.invitesSomeone: Someone from the household invites you to add music.
guest.privacy: Your name shows on the tracks you add. nexmix keeps nothing else.
guest.badName: A name has 1 to {{max}} characters, without control characters.
guest.empty: Still empty. Find tracks under Search.
guest.full: You added as many tracks as the invitation allows.
guest.listenFailed: Listening does not work right now.

ended.title: The invitation is over
ended.text: Thanks for joining in! Your tracks stay in the playlist.

removed.title: You are no longer in
removed.text: The host took you out of this playlist. Your tracks stay in it.

unknown.title: This invitation is not valid
unknown.text: Maybe it is over already. Ask for a new link or code.

server.accountsHint: Regular users have their own account in nexmix, with a password or through a sign-in provider. They need no Plex account. Guests of a playlist have no account.
server.inviteText: Whoever follows the link makes an account of their own. Without a mail server you copy the link and pass it on yourself.
server.givePassword: Send a link for a password

promote.text: {{name}} may then change every setting of this server.

demote.text: {{name}} becomes a member and no longer reaches the server's settings.

reset.title: Remove the second factor of {{name}}?
reset.text: For a lost phone: the code from the app, the passkeys and the recovery codes go, every device is signed out, and the person is told. At the next sign-in they set the second factor up again.

signout.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
signout.text: Every device of the account has to sign in again.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.text: {{name}} no longer gets in, open sessions end at once. Unblocking works at any time.

unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock.text: {{name}} can sign in again afterwards, with their own password or through the sign-in provider.

backup_restore.title: Restore this backup?
backup_restore.text: The current state is backed up first. nexmix restarts, everybody signs in again.

backup_download.title: Download this backup?
backup_download.text: It holds every account and the server's secrets, but no music. It is not encrypted.

backup_upload.title: Upload a backup?
backup_upload.text: The file joins the list of backups. Nothing is restored until you confirm it there.

two_factor_off.title: Stop requiring a second factor?
two_factor_off.text: Then a password alone is enough again to open an account. Whoever has a second factor already keeps it.

link.title: Send {{name}} a link to reset the password?
link.text: The person chooses their password themselves. The link goes by mail to their address when mail is set up, otherwise you get it once to pass on. The second factor stays.

unlink.title: Unlink {{name}}?
unlink.text: {{name}} no longer signs in through {{provider}} afterwards and is told. The account can link itself again when needed.

server.twoFactorRequiredHint: Every account that signs in with a password must set it up before it gets any further. Accounts from the provider bring their own. An account with a password is not affected either when it comes in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
server.ownSecondFactorFirst: Set up your own second factor first (My account, Security), or you would be the first one who cannot go on. Not affected is whoever signs in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
server.secretKept: stored, leave empty to keep it
server.mailHint: For sending: invitations, "Forgot your password?", confirming mail addresses, the notice of a new sign-in. Without a server the link to copy is enough, and "Forgot your password?" is missing at sign-in.
server.backupsHint: One file with the database, the settings and the server's secrets: accounts, devices, keys, settings. With the server's secret it also holds the mail credentials, so keep it protected, like a password. Restoring shows a trial run first.
server.uploadedHint: Uploaded. It is in the list now: check it first, then restore.
server.checkOk: Readable: {{accounts}}. Restoring replaces the current state; it is backed up first.
server.checkBad: Damaged: this backup cannot be restored.
server.restarting: nexmix restarts with the backup. The page reloads in a moment.
server.languagesHint: German and English are built in. Add more as a JSON file; missing texts fall back to English.
server.languageAdded: Language added. It appears under My account, Profile.
server.logHint: What the server did. Without passwords, keys and contents.
server.logClearText: Every line goes. This cannot be undone. New ones come as before.
server.checkNewer: This backup comes from a newer version of nexmix. Update nexmix first, then restore.

push.title: Web Push
push.text: So that notices reach the phone and the browser: of a new sign-in, of a second factor that was reset or an account that was unlinked from a sign-in provider. Operators also hear when a restore fails. Set up from the start; each person signs up their devices under My account.
push.contactHint: The services of Google, Apple and Mozilla ask for an address where they reach the operator. It stands in every message, nothing else of yours.
push.keysText: nexmix made a key pair of its own. Making a new one signs every device off; each person has to sign them up again.
push.renewText: Every device is signed off. Each person has to sign them up again under My account, Devices and apps.
push.renewed: New key pair made. Every device is signed off.
push.hostsHint: Messages go only to the services of Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft. If a browser needs another one, enter its host here, one per line, such as push.example.com.
push.out: What goes out: an encrypted message to the push service of each browser. Only the device can read it. It never holds anything a person stored.

server.linkSent: The link for {{name}} went to {{email}}. It works once and for 24 hours.
server.linkShown: The link for {{name}}, shown only now, valid once and for 24 hours. Pass it on, the person chooses the password themselves:

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.text: Programs read with a key that each person makes under My account. Here you allow that and see every key, never the key itself.
apiKeys.allowHint: Off: nobody can make keys, and existing ones stop working.
apiKeys.blockText: It stops working at once, for good. The account sees it blocked in its list.
apiKeys.offHint: A key only reads and never does more than its account may.

interface.title: Interface
interface.text: Everything the web app can do works through /api/v1 as well. Helpers and programs of your own build on it.
interface.schemaText: OpenAPI, for tools and code generators
interface.docsOff: The description is off from the start, so that a server on the internet does not show its routes to anybody. Turn it on with the environment variable NEXMIX_API_DOCS=1 and a restart.
interface.authText: device or key in the header of every request; they need no password and no session
interface.limits: Limit per key: 120 requests a minute. Wrong keys count like wrong passwords.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.text: The account of {{name}} will be deleted.
remove.typeName: To confirm, type the account name {{name}}
remove.cannotUndo: The account, its sessions, devices and keys are lost and cannot be brought back.

restorePreview.revivedDevices_one: Restoring makes {{count}} device valid again that was locked out or removed since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedDevices_other: Restoring makes {{count}} devices valid again that were locked out or removed since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedKeys_one: Restoring makes {{count}} key valid again that was blocked since the backup.
restorePreview.revivedKeys_other: Restoring makes {{count}} keys valid again that were blocked since the backup.

server.sizeNote: The backup is made while nexmix runs, through SQLite's own backup function, nothing stalls. Download, delete and restore ask for your password.
server.backupNoMusicText: It holds the database, the settings and the secrets of the server. The music stays in Plex.

guests.title: Guests
guests.text: Defaults for new invitations. Each invitation can set it differently.
guests.previewHint: 30 seconds, from a good third into the track

errors.account_locked: Too many wrong tries. The account waits a quarter of an hour.
errors.api_off: The operator has not switched API keys on.
errors.avatar_not_a_picture: This is not a picture nexmix takes (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC or AVIF).
errors.avatar_too_large: The picture is too large, at most {{max_mb}} MB.
errors.backup_damaged: The backup is damaged. Nothing was changed.
errors.backup_invalid: This is not a nexmix backup.
errors.backup_too_large: The backup unpacks to more than a backup may hold. Nothing was changed.
errors.backup_too_new: The backup comes from a newer version of nexmix. Nothing was changed.
errors.bad_preference: nexmix does not offer this value.
errors.busy: nexmix is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot take the operator role from yourself.
errors.client_required: The request did not say which tab it came from. Reload the page.
errors.display_name_invalid: A display name cannot hold control or invisible characters.
errors.display_name_taken: Another account goes by this name.
errors.display_name_too_long: The display name is too long, at most 80 characters.
errors.duration_not_allowed: This duration is not possible here.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.invalid_account_name: A sign-in name has 2 to 64 characters: letters without accents, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore, no spaces.
errors.invalid_days: Choose one of the offered lifetimes.
errors.invalid_email: This is not a mail address.
errors.invite_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid.
errors.issuer_invalid: This is not an OpenID Connect provider.
errors.locale_unusable: This language file cannot be used.
errors.log_level_from_environment: The level is fixed in the environment (NEXMIX_LOG_LEVEL).
errors.mail_failed: The mail server did not take the mail.
errors.mail_off: No mail server is set up.
errors.not_found: Not found, or not open to you.
errors.oidc_account: This account signs in through the provider.
errors.operator_network: The operator's settings can be reached from the home network only.
errors.operator_only: Only the operator may do this.
errors.origin_refused: The API is for programs, not web pages.
errors.own_second_factor_first: Set up your own second factor first, on your account page.
errors.password_login_off: Sign-in with a password is turned off.
errors.password_mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
errors.password_too_short: The password is too short, at least 12 characters.
errors.provider_first: Set up a sign-in provider first, or nobody but you gets in any more.
errors.public_url_missing: For mail, nexmix needs its public address; the operator sets it under Settings.
errors.second_factor_expired: Too many wrong codes, or waited too long. Start over with the password.
errors.second_factor_setup_required: Set up your second factor first.
errors.second_factor_unavailable: The second factor cannot be checked on this installation. Ask the operator to reset it.
errors.setup_code_wrong: The setup code is wrong. It stands in the server's log.
errors.slow_down: Too many requests with this key. Wait a minute.
errors.token_wrong_kind: This is the wrong kind of key for this route: device tokens and API keys are two different things.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than allowed, at most {{max_mb}} MB.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.totp_code_wrong: The code is not right. A code from the app: check the time on the phone. A recovery code works once only.
errors.totp_enabled: The second factor is on already.
errors.totp_enrolment_expired: Setting up took too long. Start again.
errors.totp_not_enabled: The second factor is not on.
errors.unknown_language: nexmix does not have this language.
errors.use_disable: Turn your own second factor off on your account page.
errors.push_endpoint_invalid: This is not the address of a push service.
errors.push_service_unknown: nexmix sends nothing to this push service. The operator can add it under Settings › Web Push.
errors.push_unreachable: The server cannot reach the push service.
errors.push_keys_invalid: The keys of this device are not valid.
errors.push_too_many_devices: At most {{max}} devices. Sign one off first.
errors.push_name_invalid: Use a shorter name without control characters.
errors.push_no_devices: Turn it on for this device first.
errors.push_contact_invalid: Give an address starting with mailto: or https://.
errors.push_host_invalid: This is not a host name: {{entry}}
errors.push_too_often: Too much at once. Wait a minute.
errors.second_factor_required: The operator requires a second factor. You cannot turn off the last one.
errors.sign_in_again: Sign in again through the provider, then try once more right away.
errors.this_session: Here you sign out with “Sign out”.
errors.not_in_setup: There is nothing to confirm any more. Reload the page.
errors.passkey_expired: That took too long. Start again.
errors.passkey_invalid: The browser's answer does not fit. Try again.
errors.passkeys_need_https: Passkeys work only when nexmix is reached over https (or on localhost).
errors.too_many_passkeys: No more than ten passkeys per account.
errors.passkey_cancelled: Cancelled. The browser did not hand over a passkey.
errors.passkey_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys here.
errors.reset_invalid: This link does not work any more.
errors.reset_off: This is not set up on this server. Ask the operator.
errors.use_account_page: You change your own password under My account.
errors.browser_only: This needs a signed-in browser, not a device.
errors.device_name_invalid: The name of a device has 1 to 80 characters, without control characters.
errors.too_many_devices: That is enough devices: block one first.
errors.too_many_keys: That is enough keys: delete one first.
errors.email_same: This is your confirmed address already.
errors.email_link_invalid: This link does not work any more.
errors.name_mismatch: The name does not match. Type it exactly as shown.
errors.key_scope: This key is not meant for this.
errors.plex_timeout: Plex did not answer in time.
errors.plex_refused: Plex refused the token. Connect Plex again.
errors.plex_busy: Plex is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.plex_not_found: Plex does not know this any more.
errors.preview_too_often: That is enough listening in for this hour. Please wait a little.
errors.preview_busy: Too many people are listening in right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.smart_playlist: Smart playlists from Plex can only be viewed here. Change them in Plex.
errors.smart_not_here: This smart playlist only exists on its own Plex server. It is not made here as an ordinary playlist.
errors.no_note: There is no order from Plex left to take.
errors.library_gone: The library is gone from Plex. Choose another one.
errors.plextv_unreachable: plex.tv cannot be reached. Does the server have access to the internet?
errors.pin_expired: The sign-in at Plex has run out. Start it again.
errors.bad_url: The address must look like http://plex:32400
errors.bad_token: The token is missing or has spaces in it.
errors.address_refused: nexmix does not take this address.
errors.no_music_library: This server has no music library.
errors.token_unreadable: The stored token cannot be read any more. Connect Plex again.
errors.replaced: The library was changed in the meantime.
errors.disconnected: Plex was disconnected in the meantime.
errors.interrupted: The server was stopped in the meantime.
errors.stopped: The server was stopped in the meantime.
errors.read_only: This playlist is shared with you to see, not to change.
errors.not_owner: Only the owner and the operator may do this.
errors.in_trash: The playlist is in the trash. Bring it back first.
errors.not_in_trash: Move the playlist to the trash first.
errors.too_many_playlists: An account holds at most {{max}} playlists. Move one to the trash, then a new one fits.
errors.playlist_full: A playlist holds at most {{max}} tracks.
errors.share_needless: This person sees the playlist anyway.
errors.no_catalog: The catalogue is not there yet.
errors.invite_unknown: This invitation is not valid (any more).
errors.invite_full: This invitation already has as many guests as it takes.
errors.no_invite: There is no invitation to change. Open the dialog again.
errors.guest_required: Open the link of the invitation first.
errors.guest_removed: The host took you out of this playlist.
errors.guest_limit: You added as many tracks as the invitation allows ({{max}}).
errors.guest_no_adding: This invitation does not let guests add tracks.
errors.guest_no_sorting: This invitation does not let guests sort.
errors.guest_not_yours: You may remove only your own tracks.
errors.bad_name: A name has 1 to {{max}} characters, without control characters.
errors.too_many_streams: You have this playlist open on too many pages already.
errors.jellyfin_refused: Jellyfin refused the sign-in. Connect Jellyfin again.
errors.jellyfin_timeout: Jellyfin did not answer in time.
errors.jellyfin_starting: Jellyfin is starting. Try again in a minute.
errors.jellyfin_bad_request: Jellyfin did not take the request.
errors.quick_expired: The code has run out. Get a new one.
errors.quick_off: Quick Connect is switched off in this Jellyfin. Connect with an API key.
errors.not_jellyfin: No Jellyfin answers at this address.
errors.invalid_server: There is no such media server here.

ready.title: Ready for the internet?
ready.text: Many reach nexmix from on the road too. nexmix checks this itself, every time you open the page.

https.title: Public address with https
https.warn: {{address}} has https, but this request came without. Open nexmix under that address, or let the proxy send X-Forwarded-Proto and name it in NEXMIX_TRUSTED_PROXIES.
https.bad: Without https, passwords travel the network in the clear, and Web Push and passkeys do not work at all. Enter the public address with https below.

two_factor.title: Second factor for everybody
two_factor.ok: Whoever signs in with a password needs a code or a passkey as well.
two_factor.warn: Off, as it comes. Recommended when nexmix is reachable from the internet: there a guessed or stolen password is enough to open an account. Turn on "Require a second factor" below.

own_account.title: Your own account
own_account.warn: Has no second factor. Recommended when nexmix is reachable from the internet and you sign in with a password, as this account may change everything. Set it up under My account, Security.

brake.title: Protection against guessing
brake.ok: After 5 wrong tries a 15 minute pause, per account and per address. Every try is in the log.
brake.warn: All visitors come through a proxy nexmix does not know: the pause holds per account, per address only roughly. See “Behind the proxy”.
brake.bad: The list of trusted proxies holds public networks ({{networks}}). Anybody could then make up the sender's address, and the pause after wrong tries no longer holds. List only the address of your proxy.
brake.broken: The protection against guessing fails its own test. Restart nexmix; if that does not help, please report it.

cookies.title: Sessions and cookies
cookies.ok_one: Cookies only over https and not readable by scripts; a sign-in runs out after {{count}} day without use.
cookies.ok_other: Cookies only over https and not readable by scripts; a sign-in runs out after {{count}} days without use.
cookies.warn: Without https the sign-in cookies travel in the clear. Over https nexmix protects them by itself.
cookies.bad: NEXMIX_COOKIE_SECURE is off: the cookies go unprotected even over https. Set it to auto.

proxy.title: Behind the proxy
proxy.ok: The visitors' real address arrives (proxy {{proxies}} entered as trusted). Without that the protection against guessing would see everybody as one.
proxy.direct: The visitors arrive directly, without a proxy in between.
proxy.warn: The requests come through a proxy ({{proxy}}) that is not entered as trusted: the protection against guessing sees everybody as one. Set NEXMIX_TRUSTED_PROXIES to its address.
proxy.bad: Public networks are listed as trusted ({{networks}}). Set NEXMIX_TRUSTED_PROXIES to the address of your proxy, not to the whole internet.

secrets.title: Server secrets
secrets.ok: The key for the OIDC secret and the mail password can be read by the owner only.
secrets.env: The key comes from NEXMIX_SECRET_KEY, not from a file.
secrets.bad: The file {{path}} can be read by others too (mode {{mode}}). Set it to 600, the owner only.

backups.title: Backup
backups.ok: An automatic backup is on. The music stays in Plex.
backups.warn: No automatic backup. Turn it on under Settings, Backup.

jellyfin.title: Jellyfin
jellyfin.ok: Jellyfin is connected inside the own network. nexmix passes sound and pictures through; no browser sees ids or the address.
jellyfin.warn: Jellyfin ({{names}}) is connected at an address outside the own network. Jellyfin hands out sound and pictures without a sign-in. nexmix never passes ids on, but an address inside the own network is safer.
jellyfin.bad: There is no readable key for Jellyfin ({{names}}). Connect Jellyfin again.

mail.title: Mail address
mail.text: For "Forgot your password?" and notices such as a new sign-in. A new address counts only after you open the link in the mail sent to it.
mail.sent: Link sent. Until you open it, the old address stays.
mail.off: The operator has not set up a mail server yet, so no link can be sent.
mail.passwordHint: For safety: the address is the way back into the account.
mail.passwordFirst: Enter the password above for that

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.text: For your own scripts or a dashboard. A key can only read, never change settings.
apiKeys.off: The operator has not allowed API keys.
apiKeys.offForOperator: API keys are not allowed yet.
apiKeys.enableText: After that every person on this server can make keys under My account. A key lets a program only read, never more than the account that made it may. You can switch this off again under Settings, API at any time; keys that exist stop working then too.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.lifetimeHint: A key that never runs out is the one nobody remembers when it falls into the wrong hands. A year is usually enough; the list shows a week ahead that it runs out.
apiKeys.docs: Everything the web app can do works through the interface under /api/v1 as well. The description is at /api/v1/docs.

devices.title: Device tokens
devices.text: A phone, an app or a script speaks for your account with a token of its own. You see the token only once.
devices.name: Name of the device
devices.shownOnce: This is the token for {{name}}. Copy it now, nexmix does not show it again.

device.title: Remove {{name}}?
device.text: The device can no longer sign in afterwards. The token cannot be brought back, but you can make a new one at any time.

apiKey.title: Delete the key?
apiKey.text: Programs with the key "{{name}}" can no longer reach nexmix afterwards. This cannot be undone.

session.title: End the session?
session.text: The browser of this session is signed out afterwards and has to sign in again.

pushDevice.title: Remove the device?
pushDevice.text: "{{name}}" gets no more notifications afterwards until it signs up again.

invite.title: Withdraw the invitation?
invite.text: The link of the invitation stops working. This cannot be undone, but a new invitation is always possible.

locale.title: Remove the language?
locale.text: The uploaded language "{{name}}" is deleted. Whoever chose it sees the default language afterwards.

avatar.title: Remove the profile picture?
avatar.text: The picture is deleted. You can upload a new one at any time.

logoutOthers.title: Sign out everywhere else?
logoutOthers.text: All other browsers are signed out afterwards and have to sign in again. Paired devices stay.

mailPending.title: Withdraw the new mail address?
mailPending.text: The link sent to {{address}} stops working. You can enter the address again at any time and have a new link sent.

mailAddress.title: Remove the mail address?
mailAddress.text: The address {{address}} is deleted. Without an address there is no link to reset the password and no notices by mail. You can enter a new one later.

oidcLink.title: Unlink the account?
oidcLink.text: Afterwards you no longer sign in with {{name}} but with your password. The link can be made again later.

storage.title: Storage
storage.text: What the data folder holds and where it lies.
storage.network: The data folder lies on a network share
storage.networkText: SQLite can lose data there. Keep the data folder on a local disk.
storage.musicNote: nexmix does not count the music: it lies in Plex.

manifest.description: Build playlists together from your Plex music library.

plex.title: Plex
plex.textConnected: Connected to your Plex account. Every playlist lives in this one account.
plex.textByHand: Connected to your Plex server, by address and token. Every playlist lives in this one account.
plex.textNew: nexmix builds playlists from your Plex music library. Connect your Plex account, and every playlist lives in this one account.
plex.byHandText: For servers without a sign-in through plex.tv. Plex Web shows the token under “Get Info” › “View XML”, in the address as X-Plex-Token.
plex.waiting: Sign in to Plex in the new window and allow access. nexmix is waiting for it.
plex.blocked: The browser did not open the window.
plex.expired: The sign-in at Plex has run out. Start it again.
plex.chooseServer: Choose the server with your music.
plex.noServers: Your Plex account has no server with a music library that answers.
plex.lastSyncedValue: {{when}} · then only what is new, every 15 minutes
plex.searchValue: inside nexmix, Plex is never asked while you type
plex.nightlyLabel: Time of the nightly whole sync, empty for off
plex.nightlyFailed: Not saved, the old time still holds.
plex.disconnectText: nexmix forgets the token and the catalogue of {{tracks}} tracks. Search and suggestions only work again once you connect Plex anew and the catalogue has been fetched. The only way back is to connect again. Nothing changes in Plex itself.
plex.libraryText: The catalogue of “{{old}}” is deleted and the one of “{{new}}” is fetched. Until then there is no search. The only way back is to choose “{{old}}” again and have it fetched anew.
plex.kept: The catalogue of {{when}} stays until it works again.
plex.analysisOffText: Without it, suggestions come from mood, style, genre and decade. With it, nexmix finds tracks that really sound alike. Switch it on in Plex under Edit library › Advanced › Sonic analysis. With many tracks the server works on it for a few nights.
plex.analysisRunningText: Plex works on it at night, in its maintenance window. Until every track is analysed, suggestions come mostly from mood, style, genre and decade.
plex.analysisOnText: nexmix uses it to find tracks that really sound alike.
plex.previewAllowedHint: Off: nobody listens in, guests neither. On: 30 seconds from a good third of the track, passed through nexmix. Your Plex key stays on the server.

editor.deleteText: “{{name}}” then lies in the trash for {{days}} days and can be restored until then.
editor.goneTrash: This playlist is in the trash now.
editor.goneShare: This playlist is no longer shared with you.
editor.notFound: This playlist does not exist, or it is not shared with you.
editor.emptyText: Search on the left and add with +, or use “Fill by mood” above.
editor.grip: Drag to sort, or Alt and an arrow key
editor.plexRefused: Plex does not take this track
editor.plexElsewhere: Not found on this Plex server
editor.noMoods: {{kind}} has no moods. Genre and decade work.

share.title: Share
share.text: Who may see “{{name}}” or help build it.
share.nobody: There are no other members yet. The operator invites people under Settings.
share.operator: The operator sees every playlist anyway.
share.unshareText: {{name}} then no longer sees “{{playlist}}”. You can share it again any time.

preview.tooOften: That is enough listening in for this hour. It works again in {{minutes}} min.
preview.failed: The preview could not be played.

suggest.title: Suggestions
suggest.fromLast_one: Fitting the last track of the list
suggest.fromLast_other: Fitting the last {{count}} tracks of the list
suggest.basis: from mood, style, genre and decade
suggest.basisSound: from mood, style, genre, decade and sound
suggest.none: Nothing new fits right now. Try another kind.
suggest.noSeedText: Add a few tracks or start with a mood. Suggestions then come by themselves.
suggest.soundOff: With Plex's sonic analysis, tracks that really sound alike would join here. It is switched off in your library.
suggest.soundRunning: Plex is analysing the sound of your tracks, {{percent}} % are done. Once these are among them, tracks that sound alike join here.
suggest.basisNoMoods: from genre, decade and how well known

mood.title: Fill by mood
mood.text: Choose how it should sound. nexmix proposes tracks from your library, you tick what goes in.
mood.nothing: Nothing in your library fits that. Choose more moods or other decades.

servers.addText: Connect more libraries. Every playlist takes its tracks from one server, chosen when it is made.
servers.plexText: Another Plex server beside the first one. Playlists that take their tracks from here are saved in this server.
servers.plexAddText: Sign in with Plex or give the address and the token. The first Plex server stays as it is.
servers.disconnectText: nexmix forgets the token and the catalogue with {{tracks}} tracks. Playlists that take their tracks from this server stay in nexmix, but search, suggestions and listening in only work again once you connect it again. Only connecting again brings this back. Nothing changes on the server itself.

jellyfin.title: Jellyfin
jellyfin.textNew: Connect a Jellyfin server. You confirm nexmix in Jellyfin with a code; no password is typed here.
jellyfin.addressHint: For example http://jellyfin:8096. Best an address inside the own network.
jellyfin.byKeyText: Make an API key in Jellyfin under Dashboard › API Keys.
jellyfin.codeText: Open Jellyfin, go to Quick Connect in your profile and enter this code. nexmix waits for it.
jellyfin.chooseUser: Choose the Jellyfin user the playlists will belong to in Jellyfin. Their plays show which tracks are well known.
jellyfin.moodsValue: Jellyfin has none; genre and decade work
jellyfin.playlistsValue: live in nexmix only for now. nexmix does not make any in Jellyfin yet.
jellyfin.disconnectText: nexmix forgets the token and the catalogue with {{tracks}} tracks. Playlists with tracks from Jellyfin stay in nexmix, but search, suggestions and listening in only work again once you connect Jellyfin again. Only connecting again brings this back. Nothing changes in Jellyfin itself.
jellyfin.libraryText: The catalogue of "{{old}}" is deleted and the one of "{{new}}" fetched. Until then there is no search. It only comes back if you choose "{{old}}" again and it is fetched anew.
jellyfin.searchValue: inside nexmix, Jellyfin is never asked while you type
